scripts.generate: npm run generate:ui && npm run generate:transport && npm run generate:commands
scripts.check:extension: npm run generate && tsc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.background.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.admin.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.transport.json --noEmit
scripts.render:chrome-web-store-screenshots: npm run build:extension && node tools/test-isolated.mjs extension --export-store-listing-assets
scripts.render:chrome-web-store-listing: npm run render:chrome-web-store-assets && npm run render:chrome-web-store-screenshots
scripts.build:relay:release: npm run build:relay:windows-x64 && npm run build:relay:linux-x64
scripts.build:dev-package:extension: npm run build:extension && node tools/package-dev.mjs extension
scripts.build:dev-package:local-app: npm run build:relay:release && node tools/package-dev.mjs local-app
scripts.build:dev-package: npm run build:extension && npm run build:relay:release && node tools/package-dev.mjs
scripts.test:runtime-core: node --test tests/transport-context.test.mjs tests/offscreen-diagnostic.test.mjs tests/onboarding.test.mjs tests/tab-service-races.test.mjs tests/occupation-service.test.mjs tests/browser-service.test.mjs tests/page-tree-session.test.mjs tests/page-tree-projection.test.mjs tests/page-tree-find.test.mjs tests/page-wait.test.mjs tests/command-defaults.test.mjs tests/dom-actions.test.mjs tests/artifact-files.test.mjs tests/demo-files.test.mjs tests/artifact-upload.test.mjs tests/demo-service.test.mjs tests/storage-services.test.mjs tests/capture-service.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:relay
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:extension && npm run test:ui-i18n && npm run test:icons && npm run test:readme-i18n && npm run test:key-core && npm run test:runtime-core && npm run test:client-websocket && npm run test:chrome-web-store-package && npm run test:relay
scripts.test:runtime: npm run test:unit && node tools/test-isolated.mjs all
